source.content: public class CoreRuntimeLocalSandboxCopy implements SandboxPostCopy { public void runApexClass(SandboxContext context) { System.assertEquals('00D000000000001', String.valueOf(context.organizationId())); System.assertEquals('0GR000000000001', String.valueOf(context.sandboxId())); System.assertEquals('preview', context.sandboxName()); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeLocalRequestSandboxTest { @isTest static void runsLocalRequestAndSandboxGetters() { Request request = Request.getCurrent(); System.assertEquals('glade-request-000000000001', request.getRequestId()); System.assertEquals('RUNTEST_SYNC', request.getQuiddity().name()); System.assertEquals('glade-request-000000000001', RequestImpl.getCurrent().getRequestId()); UIRequest uiRequest = UIRequest.getCurrent(); System.assertEquals('local.glade.example', uiRequest.getRequestHeader('host')); System.assertEquals('local.glade.example', uiRequest.getRequestHeader('Host')); System.assertEquals(null, uiRequest.getRequestHeader('x-missing')); Test.testSandboxPostCopyScript(new CoreRuntimeLocalSandboxCopy(), '00D000000000001', '0GR000000000001', 'preview', true); } }
